name: NPC Frost Armor 12544 does not proc Chilled from Blackjack (#11799)
contract: NPC Frost Armor 12544 (cast out of combat by Razormane Geomancer 3269 at Thorn Hill and 121 other NPCs)
has Spell.dbc ProcFlags 40 (taken melee auto-attack or melee-class spell) and triggers Chilled 6136 at 100%
chance. Like player Frost Armor (-168), Ice Armor (-7302), and Molten Armor (-30482), it must carry a
spell_proc row with SpellTypeMask 1 (PROC_SPELL_TYPE_DAMAGE), HitMask 1027 (NORMAL|CRITICAL|ABSORB), and
AttributesMask 2 (PROC_ATTR_TRIGGERED_CAN_PROC). Without that row, SpellMgr::LoadSpellProcs assigns
PROC_SPELL_TYPE_MASK_ALL (7), so non-damaging melee spells without SPELL_ATTR3_SUPPRESS_CASTER_PROCS
(Ranger Blackjack 520568 and Rogue Sap 6770) proc Chilled 6136 on hit, breaking Elude 801345 stealth.
With the fix, casting Blackjack and Sticky Fingers 804669 on a Frost-Armored Razormane Geomancer keeps
Elude active, leaves both units out of combat, and does not apply Chilled 6136; a damaging melee attack
still procs Chilled 6136 as a positive control.
